sections.content: A must-visit horological sanctuary in Seoul. Vacheron Constantin showcases 270 years of Swiss high watchmaking art in Gangnam/Seongsu space.

sections.source: KULT SEOUL TOURIST GUIDE | SPATIAL DISCOVERY
sections.content: Explore Seongsu-dong, the Brooklyn of Seoul. Concrete architecture, olfactory scent bars, and exclusive flagship popups.
